segments.name: Banking business
segments.description: The Bank's single operating segment, covering its banking business as managed by its Management.
segments.evidence: For management purposes, the Bank's Management has determined that it has only one operating segment related to the banking business.

revenueModel.text: The Bank earns net interest income and commissions income from its banking business, the income lines it reports in its statement of income.
revenueModel.evidence: Commissions income divided by the sum of net interest income plus commissions income.
